metadata.title: UI Starter
metadata.description: A neutral starter base: auth, app-shell, i18n and UI primitives, ready for your product.

auth.loginSubtitle: Pick up where you left off.
auth.name: Full name
auth.authErrorEmailTaken: An account already exists with this email. Log in instead.
auth.authErrorSignup: Account creation failed. Try again in a moment.
auth.authErrorConfirmEmail: Account created. Check your inbox and click the confirmation link to log in.

cookieBanner.body: This site uses analytics cookies to improve the experience. They are only set with your consent; necessary cookies stay active. Cookie policy.

forgot.title: Forgot your password?
forgot.subtitle: Enter your email and we'll send you a link to choose a new one.
forgot.sentBody: If an account exists with this email, you'll receive a reset link. Check your spam folder too.

legal.placeholderNotice: Placeholder legal text — replace before production. This starter ships no real legal content: fill in your company identity and your own terms.
legal.mentionsBody: State here the site's publisher (company name, legal form, registered office, registration, contact), the publication director and the host.
legal.cgvBody: Describe here your offers and their prices, ordering and payment terms, delivery, the right of withdrawal, refunds, liability and applicable law.
legal.privacyBody: Describe here the data you collect, the purposes and legal bases, the recipients and processors, the retention periods and the data subjects' rights.
legal.cookiesBody: Describe here the cookies you set (strictly necessary, preferences, consent-based analytics) and how to manage your choice.

newPassword.title: Choose a new password.
newPassword.subtitle: 8 characters minimum.
newPassword.error: This link has expired or was already used. Request a new one.

settings.passwordNoAccount: This account signs in with Google — there's no password to change.
settings.deleteAccountNote: Permanently delete your account and all your data.
settings.deleteModalBody: This permanently deletes your account and all associated data. This action is irreversible.
settings.deleteConfirmEmail: Retype your email address to confirm
settings.deleteError: The address doesn't match, or the deletion failed.

home.title: Starter base
home.subtitle: A neutral foundation, ready for your product. Replace this content with your own.

admin.title: Administration
admin.subtitle: Admin-only area. Add your administration tools here.

demo.notice: Fake data — nothing is saved server-side; use "Reset" to start over.

pricing.title: Simple, transparent pricing
pricing.subtitle: One plan, everything you need. Cancel anytime.
pricing.planProFeatures: Full access to all features, priority support.
pricing.premiumSubtitle: You have an active subscription. Thank you for your support!

gallery.title: UI Kit
gallery.subtitle: Primitives and blocks assembled from the design system — visible in development and demo mode only.
gallery.containerPreview: Max-width content, centred with responsive gutters.
gallery.cardExampleBody: Get a daily summary by email.
gallery.modalBody: The modal's content is yours — this component only owns the chrome (backdrop, card, title, close).
gallery.localeCaption: Actually switches this page's language (stays on /ui).
gallery.buttonDarkCaption: Outline and ghost are designed for the app's dark (pine) chrome — patched to a dark backdrop here so they stay legible on this light preview.
gallery.blockEmptyBody: Nothing to show yet. Check back later or adjust your filters.
